corrective_scope: Responds to the independent audit findings C1-C8 against the Batch 10.4 First Corrective packaging delivery. No Batch 10.5 work performed. No UI, clipboard, download, backup, restore, Prompt Pack, rendered-image, persistence-write, or external-integration work performed.

findings_addressed.C1: Pair-file generation now requires a genuinely selected Output A AND Output B for the same scene, with Output B.sourceOutputAId matching that Output A and plan.numbering independently confirming the relationship - the unconditional 'pair scope always emits' special case is gone; partial pair plans (missing/mismatched B) never leak prompt_pair or prompt_b.
findings_addressed.C2: Manifest reconciliation now rejects extra fileSizes/checksums keys not present in includedFiles, and rejects unsafe (backslash) bookkeeping paths - includedFiles/fileSizes/checksums path sets must reconcile exactly, not merely be a subset check.
findings_addressed.C3: Every manifest.json/checksums.sha256 mutation test now updates exactly the mutated entry's outer-ledger checksum (and, for manifest.json, checksums.sha256's own line referencing it) before verifying, proving the semantic layer rejects the tamper independently of the outer per-entry ledger, with exact failure reasons asserted.
findings_addressed.C4: The ZIP verifier now compares the complete 16-bit central-directory 'version made by' field (platform + version) instead of masking to the low byte only, so a non-MS-DOS platform byte is rejected even when the version byte still matches.
findings_addressed.C5: version_snapshot packaging now fails closed (existing EXPORT_SCOPE_001 code) instead of writing VersionSnapshot.stateHash - a whole-project state digest - into sourceFingerprints.sessionFingerprint, which is meant to be a real SessionFingerprint.hash; there is no session to describe for this scope and no schema change was made to invent one.
findings_addressed.C6: packageExport's outer catch path now returns the warnings/omissions already known from a successfully prepared plan instead of unconditionally resetting to empty arrays; proven via a narrow, test-only dependency-injection seam (packageExportWithHooksForTesting, not part of the public packaging surface) that forces a post-plan exception without monkey-patching any global API.
findings_addressed.C7: Scope-matrix tests now assert the complete, ordered array of {path, kind} entries (not a kind Set) for every supported scope, including a partial pair without B, a multi-scene session, a multi-session complete_project export, and the collision-heavy-names case - proving exact multiplicity, not just kind presence.
findings_addressed.C8: scripts/source-tree-hash.mjs now explicitly excludes CHECKPOINT-MANIFEST.json and CHECKSUMS.txt by exact relative path, fixing the unreproducible self-referential combined-hash cycle from the First Corrective; the recorded value below is stable across edits to either bookkeeping file.

source_tree_combined_hash.note: Second Corrective C8 fix: scripts/source-tree-hash.mjs now explicitly excludes CHECKPOINT-MANIFEST.json and CHECKSUMS.txt by exact relative path (documented in the script itself), because a combined hash that embeds itself in one of the files it hashes can never reproduce - the act of writing the value changes the bytes that produced it. 402 = 404 total regular files minus these 2 excluded bookkeeping files. This value is reproducible on any clean extraction: editing CHECKPOINT-MANIFEST.json or CHECKSUMS.txt afterward does not change it, since both are now outside the hashed set. Verify with: sha256sum -c CHECKSUMS.txt && node scripts/source-tree-hash.mjs.
